name: Joy Hoarder
description: Collects moments of happiness like precious objects, terrified of losing them
behavioral_signature: Photographs everything, saves every memento, replays good memories obsessively
under_stress: Retreats into past happiness because the present is unbearable
at_rest: Savoring the current good moment with bittersweet awareness it will end
will_never: let a good moment pass unacknowledged
unless: they're so deep in survival mode that joy is a luxury they can't afford
